info.description: Plain HTTP endpoints mounted on the FastMCP server alongside the MCP protocol. Use these for clients that prefer REST over MCP.

CreateCardRequest.description:
Request payload to tokenise and store a card in the Getnet vault.

All fields are required. The ``card_number`` PAN is used solely for
tokenisation and is never persisted once the ``number_token`` is obtained.

card_number.description: 16-digit primary account number (PAN). Used exclusively for tokenisation; never stored after the token is created.
card_number.title: Card Number

idempotency_key.description: Journey idempotency key forwarded to ORC when supplied.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

transaction_id.description: Optional SEP/Getnet vault transaction key forwarded when supplied.
transaction_id.title: Transaction Id

customer_id.description: Unique identifier of the customer who owns the card.
customer_id.title: Customer Id

cardholder_name.description: Full name of the cardholder exactly as it appears on the card.
cardholder_name.title: Cardholder Name

expiration_month.description: Card expiry month as a two-digit string (e.g. '01' for January, '12' for December).
expiration_month.title: Expiration Month

expiration_year.description: Card expiry year as a two-digit string (e.g. '27' for 2027).
expiration_year.title: Expiration Year

security_code.description: Card Verification Value (CVV/CVC). 3 digits for most brands, 4 digits for Amex.Optional.
security_code.title: Security Code

CreateCardRequest.title: CreateCardRequest

CreateCardResponse.description: Response returned after a card has been successfully stored in the vault.

card_id.description: Opaque identifier of the newly stored card. Use this value in payment operations and card management calls (card_payment tool, DELETE /v1/cards/<card_id>).
card_id.title: Card Id

CreateCardResponse.title: CreateCardResponse

CardResponse.description:
Compact view of a vaulted card returned by listing operations.

Exposes only non-sensitive identifiers and metadata needed by clients
(REST consumers and the ``list_cards`` MCP tool) to select a card for
subsequent payment operations. Raw PANs, number tokens and expiry data
are intentionally omitted.

card_id.description: Opaque vault identifier of the card. Use it in payment operations.
card_id.title: Card Id

seller_id.description: Unique identifier of the seller (merchant) that owns the vault entry, extracted from the caller's JWT ``sellerId`` claim.
seller_id.title: Seller Id

customer_id.description: Unique identifier of the customer who owns the card.
customer_id.title: Customer Id

last4.description: Last four digits of the card PAN, suitable for display.
last4.title: Last4

bin.description: Bank Identification Number (BIN) â the first six digits of the PAN.
bin.title: Bin
